title: members see a display name; the legal name stays with the platform

criteria.text: Signup requires a legal name; no account without it
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] retired by the newer ruling: F081 2026-11-12 'Sign up with a US mobile number and a texted code, not an email', which collects 'a name (a first or display name, never a legal name)' and tags [replaces 2026-09-14: Signup collects legal name, email and zip]; the PM: "don't ask for a legal name" (also #1299, F076 2026-11-12). What is on main is the older build: the profile screen still requires a legal name of 2-120 characters (signup/profile.ts, OnboardingFlow, signup-profile-set; #497 review-skipped) and src/proxy.ts sends a signed-in member with no legal_name to /onboarding (#1032, review-skipped; deploy-health on 730abcf cancelled, superseded by e97cdf0 green); members.legal_name is nullable. Taking the field out is F081.1 (#1280). Shown, not counted; `sync-roadmap` amends the scenario. #610 (check) and #847 (closed) were filed against the old wording.

criteria.text: Display name shown wherever a peer would see the legal name
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] the display name is collected at signup (OnboardingFlow, #497 review-skipped) and is what every peer-facing surface shows: a Page's 'Started by' line reads page_founder_public, which returns display_name only (migration 20260930180000, #249, no Reviewed by, deploy-health green on aba449d), and the following list shows display_name (get-member-follows.ts); signed out, F134 (#1278) hides the name entirely ('a neighbour'). Posts are by Pages, responses do not exist, the member profile is retired (#303). The 2026-11-12 signup rulings keep 'a first or display name', so the criterion stands. Checked: yes, tests/f077-display-name-db.test.ts marked [guards F077.2] (#1072, deploy-health green on a9d265d): the Started by read returns the display name and no legal-name column to the founder and a peer and nothing to a stranger; seen failing against a Page function that also returns legal_name. Reviewed: no, #497 skipped and #249 has none. Smoked: yes, `smoke-live` 2026-11-19 on main 05178ea (routes explore, page, you; personas signedOut, stranger, member, ownerBusiness, operator at 390 and 1280 px; 15 passed, run 44594715209; it checks only that a screen loads with no error and shows no stray email) opened `page` (where Started by shows), though it looks for stray emails, not names.

criteria.text: Legal name never on a public or discovery surface or shown to an anonymous visitor
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] holds today: members has only members_select_self (migration 20260930180000, #249; green on aba449d); the src files naming legal_name are the signup path (signup/profile.ts, OnboardingFlow, signup-profile-set, onboarding/page.tsx), the gate (proxy.ts), reports-queue.ts and ReportEntry.tsx (comments only) and tests; the F134 migration (20261113000000, #1278) opens nothing on members. No standing guard marked F077.3: the #1072 test scans src for legal_name reads and checks page_founder_public for anon, part of what #611 asks (open), not members, views or functions generally. Reviewed: no (#249 has no Reviewed by). Smoked: yes, `smoke-live` 2026-11-19 on main 05178ea (routes explore, page, you; personas signedOut, stranger, member, ownerBusiness, operator at 390 and 1280 px; 15 passed, run 44594715209; it checks only that a screen loads with no error and shows no stray email) opened explore and page, the public surfaces, but looks for stray emails, not names.

criteria.text: Operator report view shows legal name beside display name
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] not built: src/lib/admin/reports-queue.ts:30 still says 'there is no `members.legal_name` column' and ReportEntry.tsx:95 shows display name and handle only (the column exists since #497; unchanged since 2026-10-25). Now also unmeetable as written: the 2026-11-12 F081 ruling stops collecting a legal name, so a member who signs up from now on has none for the view to show; the operator would hold a verified phone instead. Does the view show the phone, the legal name where one exists, or both? Routed to scope-scenario; nothing is built against it until ruled. #608 was filed against the old text and waits.

criteria.text: Seeded/test members backfilled with a legal name or flagged
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] built part: the QA personas (supabase/seeds/personas.sql, #1041) and the Playwright fixtures (#1040) set legal_name, done 2026-10-24. Missing: the showcase members in supabase/seeds/the-good-place.sql insert no legal_name (0 matches, file unchanged since 2026-10-05), migration 20261007200000 has no backfill and none later touches the column, and nothing flags a member without one. The criterion is about seeded and test members, so the 2026-11-12 'never ask' ruling does not overtake it, but it shrinks to the seeds. Ticket #609 (open).

criteria.text: Counterparties each see the other's legal name, per interaction
criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] out of scope: 2026-09-30 ruling 'Real names between people who dealt with each other (F077, #219) are out of scope; revisit with legal counsel', and the scenario's out-of-scope line. No purchase or RSVP confirmation record exists to bind a name to
